title: The Lotus Sutra, Part 2
speaker: Nomon Tim Burnett
summary: Nomon Tim Burnett takes up chapter three of the Lotus Sutra, "A Parable," and the burning house story inside it, after a guided sit that settles the breath like a feather falling. Shariputra receives a prophecy that he will become the Buddha Flower Light, and small groups reflect on life events no one could have predicted. Nomon then reads the burning house story, where a father lures his absorbed children out with promised carts. Nomon links the children's playthings to the mind's own, and tells of replaying a mishap at a January sesshin, where a sewing project and a dryer broke the rules. The class ends on the question of why the children need carts at all.
